# AK-420 -- Missing template variables fail loudly

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | implementation |
| Status | approved (2026-09-23, messaging tech lead) |
| Work source | support ticket: a customer received "Hi undefined," |
| Integration owner | messaging team |
| Prerequisites | none |
| Blocked by | none |

## Goal

`render` in `src/email/templates.js` turns a variable that is not supplied
into the text `undefined`. It should refuse instead, naming the variable.

## Non-goals

- Any change to how present variables are rendered.

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC-1** -- rendering a template that references a variable absent from
  `vars` throws an error whose message names that variable.
  Verification: `npm run check -- --test-name-pattern="AK-420 AC-1"`
- **AC-2** -- a variable whose value is `0`, `false` or the empty string
  still renders as that value.
  Verification: `npm run check -- --test-name-pattern="AK-420 AC-2"`

## Allowed changes / write ownership

- `src/email/templates.js`
- `test/email/templates.test.js`

## Generated artifacts, migrations, exported interfaces

None generated, no migration. The exported signature `render(template, vars)`
is unchanged.
